description: FALCONAge's identifier for the clock. The value to pass to fa.score(clocks=[...]) and the key every other FALCONAge output joins on.
The clock's name as the registry records it. Usually identical to clock_id; kept separate because third-party catalogues file clocks under a display name and the two are not always the same string.
Publication year of the primary source.
The species the clock was fitted on. Not the species it can be run on: the mammalian array carries 96% of Horvath2013's CpGs, so a zebra scores at high coverage against a clock fitted on people.
possible_values: Homo sapiens; Homo sapiens and Mus musculus; Mus musculus; multiple species

description: The measurement the clock consumes: dna_methylation, clinical_chemistry, proteomic or transcriptomic.
The clock's generation in the field's own taxonomy. First generation is fitted to chronological age, second to a mortality or phenotype composite, third to a rate of change.
possible_values: causal; first; mitotic; other; pace; second; system

description: Tissues the clock was trained on, verbatim from the registry, semicolon-separated where there is more than one.

tissue coarsened to one filterable class. multi_tissue wins over whole_blood when both are present: a clock fitted across tissues is not a blood clock, and filing it as one puts it on blood shortlists it does not belong on.
possible_values: blood_derived; brain; cell_culture; multi_tissue; other_tissue; perinatal_tissue; whole_blood

description: The training population as recorded, which is an AGE GROUP and not a health status. There is no health-status field in the registry.
population coarsened to one filterable class.
possible_values: adults; all_ages; cell_culture; children; non_human; older_adults; perinatal

description: What the model was actually fitted to predict, verbatim. The single most important column for deciding what a score means, and the one most often assumed rather than read.

training_target coarsened to one filterable class. 'disease' takes priority over every other rule, because it is the only class that says the training cohort was not healthy. 'clock_output' marks a model refitted to reproduce another clock rather than to predict a phenotype, which is what the PC clocks are.
possible_values: cell_composition; chronological_age; clock_output; disease; exposure; mitotic; mortality; other; pace_of_aging; phenotype; protein_or_analyte; sex_or_chromosome; unstated

description: The trained phenotype TranslAGE publishes for this clock. An independent check on training_target by a group that is not us; where the two disagree, read the paper.
possible_values: Chronological Age; Frailty; Intrinsic Capacity; Mortality; Pace of Aging

description: What the clock's output is a prediction of, which is not always what it was trained on. A PC clock is trained on another clock's output and predicts age.
Array or assay platforms the clock was trained on.
possible_values: 27K; 27K; 450K; 27K; 450K; EPICv1; 27K; bisulfite sequencing; 450K; 450K; EPICv1; EPICv1; EPICv1; 450K; Horvath MammalMethylChip40; Horvath MammalMethylChip40; Horvath MammalMethylChip320; RRBS; bisulfite sequencing; clinical laboratory assays; mammalian methylation array; targeted bisulfite sequencing

description: Number of features (CpGs, or markers for a clinical clock) in the published model. Where this disagrees with the shipped coefficient count the registry records the discrepancy on the clock entry.
The unit of the score. Years, a proportion, a ratio, a log-hazard, or unitless.
The formal scale of the output, which decides which downstream operations are defined. This is the field that stops age acceleration being computed on a pace of aging.
possible_values: age_years; age_years_relative; divisions; gestational_weeks; mortality_log_hazard; pace_ratio; proportion; relative_score; telomere_kb

description: The downstream operations FALCONAge will perform on this clock's output. Anything absent here raises IllegalOperationError rather than returning a number.
possible_values: acceleration; correlate; difference; mean; acceleration; correlate; difference; mean; residual; compositional; correlate; difference; mean; correlate; difference; mean; rank; correlate; difference; mean; residual; correlate; hazard_ratio; mean; rank; correlate; rank

description: The fitted model form: elastic net, principal-component linear, reference-based deconvolution, neural network, and so on.

Whether the coefficients are distributable. 'bundled' ships inside the wheel and runs offline; 'licensed' is research-use-only and must be supplied by the user; 'untraced' is catalogued metadata whose coefficients have not been traced to a primary source.
yes if this clock's weights are inside the package and it can score today. This is the column to filter on when building something that has to run.
species|tissue_class|population_class|target_class. Two clocks sharing this string were fitted on the same kind of data. Sort on it to see the natural groupings.
How many clocks share this profile_key, counting this one.
The other clocks sharing this profile_key, semicolon-separated. Symmetric by construction: if A lists B, B lists A.
example: deconvolutebloodepiccd4tcell; deconvolutebloodepiccd8tcell; deconvolutebloodepicmonocyte; deconvolutebloodepicneutrophil; deconvolutebloodepicnkcell; twelvecell
blank_means: no other clock shares this training profile

description: How many clocks in the registry share this tissue_class.
How many clocks in the registry share this target_class.

The clock sharing the largest proportion of this clock's features, among those whose coefficients ship. Nearby clocks surface here: the two Lee placental variants find each other, as do stemTOC and stemTOCvitro.
blank_means: two different things, and feature_overlap_jaccard separates them: blank with a blank jaccard means this clock's features are not distributed; blank with a jaccard of 0 means they are, and it shares no feature with any other clock that also ships them

description: Jaccard index against feature_overlap_partner: shared features divided by the union. 1.0 would be an identical feature set.
blank_means: NOT zero. Blank means this clock's features are not distributed. A clock that ships coefficients and genuinely shares none reads 0.

description: Count of features shared with feature_overlap_partner.
Why the three feature_overlap columns are empty, where they are.
possible_values: features not distributed for this clock
example: features not distributed for this clock
blank_means: the overlap columns are populated and need no explanation

Whether verify_url is a DOI or a coefficient source URL.

Result of actually resolving verify_url. '200 ok' served directly. '403 publisher blocks bots; DOI registered in Crossref' means the link is good and the publisher refuses automated requests, which is the case for 44 rows, 32 of them the journal Aging.
